verdict.rationale: Paperspace's GPU cloud page says you can "Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access," and the machine docs confirm SSH connections and an authentication choice when creating a machine. One hands-on user called getting SSH access "an uphill battle" compared with the console/GUI. That describes friction, not a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on SSH key setup and root privileges (the evidence is mostly marketing copy), and independent hands-on corroboration that key-based root SSH works smoothly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: Root access, connect with SSH Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access.
